stdout:
usage: serialwrap file pull [-h] --selector SELECTOR
                            --remote REMOTE
                            [--local LOCAL]
                            [--chunk-timeout CHUNK_TIMEOUT_S]
                            [--ack-mode {auto,echo,none}]
                            [--source SOURCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --selector SELECTOR
  --remote REMOTE
  --local LOCAL
  --chunk-timeout CHUNK_TIMEOUT_S
                        整段 base64 讀取的逾時秒數（預設：沿用 profile
                        timeout_s，#157）
  --ack-mode {auto,echo,none}
                        介面對齊 file push（#161）；pull
                        端目前僅驗證、不影響行為
  --source SOURCE
